title: Masonry
whenToUse:
- When displaying images or cards with irregular heights
- When content needs to be evenly distributed in columns
- When column count needs to be responsive

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Basic usage. Set number of columns with `columns` and spacing with `gutter`.

examples.name: Responsive
examples.description: Responsive layout adapts to different screen widths. Use `columns` to specify the number of columns at different breakpoints, and `gutter` to adjust spacing between items.

examples.name: Image
examples.description: Dynamically adjust the height of images as they load.

examples.name: Dynamic
examples.description: Demonstrate how masonry layout updates dynamically. Use `item.column` to keep items in place.

examples.name: Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Masonry by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Root element, sets relative positioning, flex layout and masonry container styles

parts.name: item
parts.description: Item element, sets absolute positioning, width calculation, transition animation and masonry item styles
